edges.description: Crystal current engineering/evidence status is routed through docs/ai/CURRENT_STATE.md, with live GitHub overriding stale dated checkpoints.
Crystal architecture overview explains component topology and project-local boundaries without itself proving activation or production authorization.
The Crystal future-work ledger preserves revalidation and audit history but must be reconciled against current state before acting.
Titan current state is routed through its AI current-state document and then rechecked against live repository, PR, and CI facts when volatile.
Titan project_state.json provides deterministic machine-readable checkpoint fields complementary to the human current-state route.
CANONICAL.md documents Titan-local authority boundaries so orchestration and machine state are not confused with semantic ownership of other projects.
Issue #432 is the owner-local open surface for the established later-task reopen policy gap; same-run reopen capability does not close that gap.
Both surfaces care about reopening the right source, but the Knowledge Tree only discovers/routes sources while Titan Issue #432 concerns an owner-local execution policy trigger.
